name: Enhance.place
tagline: Enhance a photo online at 2× or 4× without an account
description:
Enhance.place offers a free online AI photo enhancer. Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image and select 2× or 4× enlargement to improve resolution and inspect the result before downloading. The browser tool needs no login or usage credits, but it uploads the selected image to a server for processing.

The online input limit is 6 MB, 8 megapixels and 8192 pixels per side, with output capped at 32 megapixels. Four-times enlargement is available for inputs up to 2 megapixels. This workflow handles one photo at a time. Video enhancement and batch processing belong to the separate ClapClip Windows application, which runs locally on compatible GPUs. Enhancement results depend on the original image and do not guarantee recovery of missing detail.
